method: After freezing the pair, returned to the adopted OER, erratum, official timetable and the current BAP entries. Recomputed credits and levels, checked the elective timetable and the progression into fieldwork and thesis, then reconsidered the UCR workbook and audience fields.
findings: The 180 EC Dutch-taught bachelor comprises a 135 EC major with 75 EC compulsory and 60 EC selected from Annex 2.1, plus 45 EC of profiling. There is no prescribed specialisation. Six compulsory courses provide 45 EC in year one. The remaining compulsory 30 EC comprises BAP 1, 2, 3 and 5. The example follows the official compulsory timetable, using the first available published elective within each required block after checking timeslot, progression, level and ordinary paired fieldwork. First year takes academic writing and nationalism and racialisation in blocks 2 and 4. Second year takes gender and sexuality, religion and media, anthropology and sustainability, and political ecologies across blocks 1–4, plus 30 EC profiling. Third year adds violence and security in block 1 and BAP 4 alongside BAP 3 in block 3, with the remaining 15 EC profiling in blocks 2 and 4. The major includes 52.5 EC at level 3 and 52.5 EC at level 2, above the minimum 37.5 EC each and the degree-level minimum of 45 EC at level 3. At least 15 EC of major coursework must address scientific and social context, supported here by methods, anthropology theory and research writing. At least 15 profiling EC must be at level 2 or above. Profiling remains open subject to permission and overlap rules.

The binding first-year threshold is 45 EC, subject to OER procedures and exceptions. The example completes 120 EC by end of year two. BAP 2 requires 45 EC of compulsory first-year study plus 75 EC of major electives or profiling. BAP 1 prepares ethnographic methods and precedes BAP 2. BAP 3 requires successful completion of BAP 1 and 2. Students collect evidence individually in an agreed paired design. The current BAP 3 catalogue expects concurrent registration for BAP 4 unless an exception is agreed and credits are unnecessary. The OER requires the extended project for students doing the project abroad. BAP 5 requires BAP 1–3, and the jointly written thesis receives individual assessment. The project requires ethics screening. The July erratum adds second-year tutoring to first-year and advanced tutoring; the portfolio is signed off in the project and adds no credits. The current compulsory timetable and current course planner identify 202600267 as the thesis, superseding the legacy linked code on the project page.

The original menu overfilled block 2. The revised example preserves an open profiling space and includes the normal BAP 4 fieldwork extension. UCR supports substantial social inquiry and has real qualitative and quantitative methods. The revised sustainability option supports community engagement through communication and policy without implying a standalone ethnographic project. The three plans retain different organising priorities and pass current offering and prerequisite checks.
